title: Budget 2027: Supply (Budget) Bill 2027 passes policy stage; committee stage 2–26 November 2026
summary: MOF press citation (Bernama): the Supply (Budget) Bill 2027, tabled on 9 October, was approved at the policy stage by a majority of the Dewan Rakyat on 29 October after a two-week debate, and moves to the committee stage from 2 to 26 November 2026. This is the Budget's spending bill; the tax measures will follow in the Finance Bill, which hasn't been tabled yet. It is a news item, not a change in law.
